## Overview
This report covers 589 YouTube comments about iPhone 17. 401 were judged relevant to the product and 307 were assigned to a named aspect. Aspect sentiment was labeled automatically by an LLM and was spot-checked on one brand's hand-labeled comments only.
Verdict rule: strength or weakness needs at least 5 comments on that side and at least 2x as many as the other side; otherwise mixed. Evidence is thin below 10 mentions.

## Strengths
- **design**: 109 mentions, 70 positive (64%), 20 negative (18%), 19 neutral
  - Complaints: Two commenters complain about the orange color [C141, C0], and two commenters find the Pro design ugly [C204, C187]. One commenter notes that the Air model digs into the pinky finger and is easy to drop [C496].
  - Praise: Several commenters praise the appearance of the base 17 and other models, highlighting the matte black, mist blue, and overall color range [C323, C143, C237, C415, C144].
- **price / value**: 41 mentions, 29 positive (71%), 7 negative (17%), 5 neutral
  - Complaints: Several commenters express frustration over the high price tag of the phones in various currencies [C341, C485, C50, C275, C194].
  - Praise: Multiple commenters highlight the base iPhone 17 as providing great value for money, a strong set of features for average users, and adaptive refresh rates [C142, C147, C231, C150, C148].
- **battery**: 28 mentions, 18 positive (64%), 6 negative (21%), 4 neutral
  - Complaints: Two commenters report poor battery life on the iPhone 17 series [C331, C123], and others complain about rapid battery drain, low capacity compared to competitors, and restrictions [C36, C102, C125].
  - Praise: Several commenters praise the battery life on the 17, 17 Air, and Pro models, stating it meets or exceeds expectations [C324, C235, C234, C509, C166].
- **camera**: 25 mentions, 15 positive (60%), 4 negative (16%), 6 neutral
  - Complaints: One commenter disputes that the cameras are better on the iPhone 17 [C133], another points out that the base model only has two cameras like the 16 [C35], another wishes they bought the Pro for the telephoto lens [C217], and one notes that macro mode activates closer to the object on the base model compared to the pro [C480].
  - Praise: Multiple commenters praise the camera capabilities, noting features like ProRes raw, lidar, 4K at 120fps, dynamic range, and overall improvements for traveling and daily use [C156, C191, C138, C284, C8].
- **weight**: 13 mentions, 10 positive (77%), 2 negative (15%), 1 neutral
  - Complaints: One commenter notes that the Pro is heavier for features barely used [C180], and another refuses to use a giant heavy phone, wishing for a mini model [C469].
  - Praise: Several commenters praise the lightness, weight balance, and reduced burden of the Air and standard models compared to older or Max versions [C545, C573, C334, C470, C316].
- **storage**: 10 mentions, 7 positive (70%), 2 negative (20%), 1 neutral
  - Complaints: One commenter dislikes iCloud limits stopping email reception [C556], and another complains that standard models in desired colors were sold out, forcing an upgrade to higher storage [C190].
  - Praise: Multiple commenters express satisfaction with doubled base storage, high capacity options like 512gb, and overall storage upgrades compared to previous phones [C152, C162, C570, C425, C256].

## Weaknesses
None

## Mixed
- **performance**: 46 mentions, 21 positive (46%), 19 negative (41%), 6 neutral
  - Complaints: Two commenters point out software and bug issues with ios26 [C506, C519], and one commenter states that software is a persistent problem across major tech companies [C504]. One commenter complains that USB 2 on a flagship device is criminal [C512], and another finds the iPhone 17 slow compared to the Samsung S26 [C97].
  - Praise: Several commenters express satisfaction with performance upgrades, future-proofing from increased RAM, cooling chambers for gaming, and overall speed compared to older models [C332, C171, C5, C158, C189].
- **display**: 18 mentions, 9 positive (50%), 5 negative (28%), 4 neutral
  - Complaints: One commenter notes weird touch accuracy when switching from Android [C62], one dislikes the holepunch/dynamic island covering content [C78], one thought the screen was burned top right [C538], one wants the plus model screen size back [C294], and one feels 120Hz refresh screens should not be considered new features [C40].
  - Praise: Several commenters praise the display upgrades, specifically the addition of Pro Motion to the base model, higher brightness for watching videos, and the option to turn off PWM [C418, C339, C571, C318, C13].
- **durability**: 17 mentions, 5 positive (29%), 6 negative (35%), 6 neutral
  - Complaints: Several commenters report concerns or issues regarding the paint scratching easily on black, blue, and orange models [C462, C466, C468, C474, C489].
  - Praise: Multiple commenters describe the devices as very solid, durable against drops, and hard to break, particularly praising the titanium and strong glass on the air [C572, C104, C214, C350, C369].

## Suggestions (hypotheses, not validated)
- **performance**: 19 of 46 comments negative; 3 comment(s) cited. Hypothesis: Upgrading to USB 3 and addressing ios26 software bugs would alleviate the hardware and performance criticisms [C506, C512, C519].
- **display**: 5 of 18 comments negative; 2 comment(s) cited. Hypothesis: Improving touch registration and offering alternative screen sizes like a plus model could address user display grievances [C62, C294].
- **durability**: 6 of 17 comments negative; 5 comment(s) cited. Hypothesis: Using a more scratch-resistant finish or stronger coating on the colored frames would prevent the reported paint chipping and scratching [C462, C466, C468, C474, C489].
